purpose: State an expectation supported by what you know.
keywords: Plain clause + はずだ; noun + のはず; な-adjective + なはず.
Ms. Tanaka should be at the station already.
This shop should be closed today.
I am sure I put the key in my bag.
Predict what should happen or say what ought to happen
formation: Plain clause + はずだ; noun + のはず; な-adjective + なはず.
restrictions: The expectation may turn out wrong; it is not an obligation.
mistake: Use の after a noun before はず.
